channel.description: Surprising facts about UAE, Saudi Arabia, and the world.

item.title: How to Check a University Is Accredited in the UAE
item.description: Before you pay a dirham, run two official checks: the federal CAA register for the institution and its programmes, and the KHDA directory for Dubai campuses.

item.title: Cairo Uber and Careem Taxi Guide
item.description: How Uber and Careem work in Cairo: pricing, car types, airport pickup, and how they compare to street taxis.

item.title: Dubai Freelance Permit Guide
item.description: Dubai's freelance permit lets independent professionals work legally without a company. Here is how the process, authorities, and costs actually break down.

item.title: How B12 Deficiency Actually Affects Vegans and Vegetarians
item.description: B12 comes almost only from animal foods. Here's why vegans are genuinely at risk, the real symptoms, and how much to supplement.

item.title: How Business Incubators and Accelerators Actually Work
item.description: Accelerators run fixed-term cohorts for equity, like Y Combinator. Incubators offer open-ended support. Here is the real difference.

item.title: How Child Life Specialists Actually Help Kids in Hospitals
item.description: Child life specialists use play and honest explanation to help hospitalized kids and families cope with medical stress.

item.title: How Digital Signatures Actually Verify a Document's Authenticity
item.description: A digital signature hashes a document, encrypts the hash with a private key, and lets anyone verify it with the matching public key.

item.title: How Diplomatic Immunity Actually Works
item.description: Diplomatic immunity is real but limited: it belongs to the state, can be waived, and does not block expulsion for crimes.

item.title: How Esports Team Sponsorship Deals Actually Work
item.description: How esports orgs turn jersey logos, content deals, and streaming exposure into their single biggest source of revenue.

item.title: How Film Color Grading Actually Shapes Mood
item.description: How colorists use color grading, not just correction, to make a scene feel cold, dangerous, nostalgic, or warm on screen.

item.title: How Mesh WiFi Systems Actually Cover a Whole House
item.description: Mesh WiFi covers a house with multiple nodes sharing one network, roaming seamlessly and rerouting automatically when a node drops.

item.title: How National Flag Colors Carry Different Symbolism Worldwide
item.description: The same flag colors mean very different things worldwide, shaped by shared political movements, not any single fixed rulebook.

item.title: How Power Naps Actually Affect Brain Performance
item.description: Power naps can boost alertness and memory, but nap length matters. Here is what sleep science says about the ideal duration.

item.title: How Progressive Muscle Relaxation Actually Works
item.description: Progressive muscle relaxation eases anxiety by deliberately tensing then releasing muscle groups. Here is the science behind why it works.

item.title: How Satellite Constellations Avoid Colliding With Each Other
item.description: How satellites like Starlink dodge each other in orbit: conjunction data, risk thresholds, and autonomous avoidance burns.

item.title: How Saudi Arabia's Female Labor Target Changed the Job Market
item.description: Saudi Arabia hit its 30% female workforce target nine years early. Now it's aiming for 40%. Here's what actually drove the change.

item.title: How Saudi Arabia's Hajj and Umrah Capacity Expansion Works
item.description: Saudi Arabia is racing toward 30 million Hajj and Umrah pilgrims a year by 2030. Here's the rail, hotels and tech making it possible.

item.title: How Screen Mirroring Sends Your Display to Another Screen
item.description: How AirPlay, Chromecast, and Miracast each send your screen to a TV: different protocols, networks, and codecs.

item.title: How Smart Home Hubs Coordinate Different Device Brands
item.description: Smart home hubs translate between brands using shared radios and the Matter standard, letting a Google, Apple, and Amazon device share one app.

item.title: How the World Happiness Report Actually Ranks Countries
item.description: The World Happiness Report doesn't add up six factors into a score. Here is what it actually measures and how the ranking really works.
